questions: Does route plus retirement composition create independently detectable interaction errors?
Can a combined engineering environment support repair of the same observed RESP regression without confusing results from different candidates?
stop_rules: No model calls before source-matched industrial task admission and capability acceptance.
One depth-three queue repair trial with engineering-lab-v1, followed by one diagnostic-only trial; same starting RTL, Spec, model, action protocol, total actions and paired private inputs.
One independent composed-task diagnostic trial only after task admission.
Preserve every started trial. Do not add replacement successes or combine historical cohorts.

Stop model expansion after three trials, 750000 reported tokens or an infrastructure/information-boundary failure. Per-trial token ceiling is checked between trials and is not an exact in-request limit.
repair_defect: RESP exit uses old response-valid value and delays registered selection after response retirement
sampling: SDK/provider defaults; no deterministic seed claimed
analysis: Separate capability availability, actual calls, exposure, candidate-bound edits and terminal/held-out results. One paired observation cannot estimate a stable tool benefit or success rate. No parameter training.
order_rationale: Fixed before any new model call. The combined entry completes actual tool acceptance before its first model request; the baseline repair follows with the same task source and paired inputs.
